summary.text: Phil Jensen is a Republican state representative from South Dakota House District 33 who is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A business owner, he previously served in the South Dakota House from 2009 to 2013 and in the State Senate from 2013 to 2021, and returned to the House in January 2021.

paragraphs.text: Phil Jensen's career experience includes owning a business.

He represented South Dakota House of Representatives District 33 from 2009 to 2013 and then South Dakota State Senate District 33 from 2013 to 2021, before winning election to the House in 2020 and assuming office on January 12, 2021.
During the 2019-2020 session, Jensen was assigned to the Senate Education Committee, the Senate Health and Human Services Committee, and the Senate Local Government Committee, which he chaired.
In the 2025-2026 session he is assigned to the House Education Committee and the House Transportation Committee.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026, and faces Democrat Kari Hall in the general election for the district's two seats.
